title: Plan Documentation Governance
goal: Keep plan documents organized around active authority, evidence reports, and validated Better Plan state.
description: Owns the plan-document boundary: docs/plan for active human-authored plans, docs/plan/reports for evidence reports, docs/rollups for current state, and docs/plan Manifest/Checkpoints files for machine-validated execution state.

title: Styio Common Foundation Plan
goal: Route shared workflow, gate, service-contract, and test-harness substrate work through one common foundation plan.
description: Covers cross-plan substrate changes that must land before dependent feature, product, or ecosystem work can safely proceed.

title: Styio Ecosystem Delivery Master Plan
goal: Coordinate styio-nightly, styio-spio, and styio-view toward one finished language product.
description: Tracks ecosystem phases, cross-repository ownership, shared contract surfaces, and release closure gates.

title: Styio Ecosystem CLI Contract Matrix
goal: Keep the active internal CLI contract mirror aligned across styio-nightly, styio-spio, and styio-view.
description: Freezes canonical command forms and owner/consumer documentation obligations for machine-readable CLI contracts.

title: Compiler Self-Explanation Decision Log
goal: Convert compiler self-explanation findings into explicit decisions, guardrails, and implementation checkpoints.
description: Owns the next Sema/IR inventory, hash-tag route retirement guardrails, canonical resource topology sequencing, parser performance prerequisites, and stream/IDE follow-up ordering.

title: Dual-Channel Source-Build Absorption
goal: Absorb the completed repo-local source-build plan into active ecosystem authority and archive the old plan when external confirmation exists.
description: Tracks M-PLAN-01: repo-local baseline is complete, but the plan remains in docs/plan until residual hardening is moved to the master plan and the spio SSOT is confirmed.

title: Algorithmic Optimization Acceptance
goal: Close algorithmic optimization acceptance with real benchmark, sanitizer, TypeTable/SymbolInterner, ReadyQueue, and remote CI evidence.
description: Merges the algorithm audit, local closeout, CI audit, and remote acceptance reports into one current execution graph; local correctness/evidence paths exist, but speedup and release readiness remain unproven.

title: Styio Block Completion and Bottom Type
goal: Deliver the frozen lexical-Block completion algebra, strict current-Block yield contract, and public never type through one compiler and source contract.
description: Covers unit fallthrough, fail-closed normal-result joins, contextual built-in never, one AST and target for both current-Block yield spellings, explicit Unit yield, structural reachability errors, Unit-only consumer typing, function-body result adaptation, removal of fabricated return values, and cross-layer conformance without implementing adjacent Optional/default/effect/ABI work.

title: Styio Unit Zero-Payload Boundaries
goal: Deliver first-class Unit across generics, collections, tasks/effects, and explicit ABI adapters without deriving logical state from payload storage.
description: Child of the Block Completion plan; owns frozen O01-Q10..Q12 and the mandatory logical-count/state versus physical-payload separation.

title: Styio Block Exit Publication and Settlement
goal: Deliver ordinary Block-result publication after deterministic lexical settlement with bounded typed failure preservation and no managed runtime or new source syntax.
description: Child of the Block Completion plan; owns frozen P01.12-A..B/O05-Q06 through one static exit-action graph, compiler-sized fixed failure storage, and complete exit-path convergence.

title: Styio Explicit Binding Initialization
goal: Deliver the frozen explicit-first-value ordinary binding rule and remove every implicit default-synthesis route.
description: Covers mandatory RHS syntax, absence of implicit Default or hidden uninitialized state, supplied-binder/schema/protocol boundaries, parser and AST invariants, Sema/IR enforcement, fixture migration, deletion of synthesized-default code and tests, and cross-layer conformance without deciding raw storage, record defaults, or topology initialization.

title: Styio Optional Absence Boundary
goal: Deliver canonical ? | T absence with a real discriminant and remove every ordinary value fallback/coalescing implementation while preserving grammar-anchored effect settlement.
description: Owns frozen O01-Q01/O01-Q06..Q07 and P01.13-B/D02: structural Optional type identity, canonical empty/present values, full payload-domain preservation, deletion of bare-pipe/??/undefined-as-absence paths, and positive protection for type, guard, and leading ?| settlement roles.

title: Styio Directional Flow and Operation Settlement
goal: Deliver one graphical left-to-right data-flow contract and the accepted Q01-A static completion algebra through one generic ?| migration.
description: Single implementation owner for frozen P01.14-A/D21 and Q01-A: one typed directional operation with Unit success, finite nominal completion families, ordinary identifier-based family(binding) arms, safe exact-once recovery, static propagation, Q01-local direct control flow, ordinary result binding, preservation of generic transfers, and one-shot deletion of task-target, bare-freeze, wildcard-discard, hard-coded-family, repair, and compatibility routes. It consumes the Q03-F bounded Outcome ABI; Q03-F alone owns complete global/TLS/JIT/CLI ambient-state deletion.

title: Styio Callable Principal Inference
goal: Deliver the approved Q02-INF definition-site principal constrained inference contract through independent call instantiation and deterministic concrete specialization.
description: Owns scoped type terms and constraints, safe rank-1 generalization for eligible final local/private callable values, stable scheme rebinding, per-use fresh instantiation, Q05-owned closed operator relation integration, concrete monomorphization and resource gates, concrete-only SGIR/backend emission, shared IDE/cache facts, and one-shot deletion of first-use AST mutation and backend type defaults.

title: Styio Exact Literals and Built-in Add
goal: Deliver the accepted exact-literal materialization and closed scalar Add contract through one bounded compiler implementation.
description: Owns exact integer and decimal facts with deterministic resource gates, failure-closed materialization and late defaults, the immutable i8 through i128 and f32/f64 Add catalog, the narrow Q02 query seam, checked integer overflow completion, strict IEEE floating execution, constant/runtime identity, tooling and cache facts, and one-shot removal of promotion, coercion, host-folding, and backend-default paths.

title: Styio Functional Evaluation and Effect Ordering
goal: Deliver the approved Q03-F strict-value, dependency-graph, explicit effect/completion ordering, exact-once, lazy-control, bounded Outcome, and proof-scoped optimization contract.
description: Sole implementation owner for EvaluationFacts, once-only ENF, typed evaluation DAG/CFG, Q01 directional-node ordering integration, lazy branches, the compiler/generated-code bounded Outcome ABI, generated/native producer migration, complete global/TLS/codegen/JIT/CLI ambient-state deletion, four independent optimizer rights, diagnostics, and structural convergence. Q01 remains the sole owner of canonical directional/settlement syntax and nodes, OperationSummary, local settlement algebra, and legacy FlowBind/redirect deletion.
